radio_ads: Glowfin Motors: used scooters, new attitudes. Honk twice for a deal.
Tired of soggy fries? Dockside Deep Fry says: crunch is a lifestyle.
Grandma Pell's Pickle Barn. Brine so strong it has opinions.
Moonbeam Mattress: sleep like you paid your parking tickets.
Lose the rust! Harbor Hank's Paint & Patch fixes dents by Tuesday.
Sparkplug Gym. Lift heavy, yell louder, first month is free.
Pothole Pals Insurance: we cover what the city won't fill.
Fizzbolt Soda. Tastes like lightning, legally speaking.
Two-Wheel Tony's: if it rolls, he sells it. If not, he pushes it.
Lighthouse Lanes Bowling. Glow pins Friday, bring your own socks.
Captain Crumb's Bakery. Day-old bread, brand-new excuses.
Need a lawyer? Call Gristle & Pike. We object to everything.
Rooftop Pigeon Repellent: because they're watching. Always.
Mopworth Car Wash. We scrub what you won't talk about.
Night Owl Diner: pancakes at 3 AM, no questions, extra syrup.
